sn44.9:1.1: atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn44.9:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn44.9:2.1: purimāni bho gotama divasāni purimatarāni sambahulānaṃ nānātitthiya samaṇabrāhmaṇānaparibbājakānaṃ kutūhalasālāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarā kathā udapādi.
sn44.9:2.2: ayaṃ kho pūraṇo kassapo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassi titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa.
sn44.9:2.3: sopi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālakataṃ uppattīsu vyākaroti:
sn44.9:2.4: asu amutra uppanno asu amutra uppannoti. yo
sn44.9:2.5: pissa sāvako uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto, tampi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālakataṃ uppattīsu vyākaroti:
sn44.9:2.6: asu amutra uppanno, asu amutra uppannoti.
sn44.9:3.5: ayampi kho ajito kesakambalo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa.
sn44.9:3.6: sopi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālakataṃ upapattīsu vyākaroti:
sn44.9:3.7: asu amutra upapanno, asu amutra upapannoti.
sn44.9:3.8: yopissa sāvako uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto, tampi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālakataṃ upapattīsu vyākaroti:
sn44.9:3.9: asu amutra upapanno asu amutra upapannoti.
sn44.9:4.1: ayampi kho samaṇo gotamo saṅghī ceva gaṇī ca gaṇācariyo ca ñāto yasassī titthakaro sādhusammato bahujanassa.
sn44.9:4.2: so’pi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālakataṃ upapattīsu vyākaroti:
sn44.9:4.3: asu amutra upapanno, asu amutra upapannoti.
sn44.9:4.4: yo pissa sāvako uttamapuriso paramapuriso paramapattipatto, tampi sāvakaṃ abbhatītaṃ kālakataṃ upapattīsu na vyākaroti:
sn44.9:4.5: asu amutra upapanno, asu amutra upapannoti.
sn44.9:4.6: api ca kho naṃ evaṃ vyākaroti:
sn44.9:4.7: “acchecchi taṇhaṃ, vivattayi saññojanaṃ, sammā mānābhisamayā antamakāsi dukkhassā”ti.
sn44.9:4.8: tassa mayhaṃ bho gotama ahudeva kaṅkhā ahu vicikicchā
sn44.9:4.9: kathannāma samaṇassa gotamassa dhammo abhiññeyyo. alaṃ
sn44.9:5.1: hi te vaccha, kaṅkhituṃ alaṃ vicikicchituṃ.
sn44.9:5.2: kaṅkhanīye ca pana te ṭhāne vicikicchā uppannā.
sn44.9:5.3: sa upādānassa kho’haṃ vaccha upapattiṃ paññāpemi no anupādānassa;
sn44.9:5.4: seyyathāpi vaccha, aggi saupādāno jalati, no anupādāno;
sn44.9:5.5: evameva kho’haṃ vaccha saupādānassa upapattiṃ paññāpemi, no anupādānassāti.
sn44.9:6.1: yasmiṃ pana bho gotama samaye acci vātena khittā dūrampi gacchati, imassa pana bhavaṃ gotamo kiṃ upādānasmiṃ paññāpetīti.
sn44.9:6.2: yasmiṃ vaccha samaye acci vātena khittā dūrampi gacchati, tamahaṃ vātūpādānaṃ vadāmi.
sn44.9:6.3: vātohissa vaccha tasmiṃ samaye upādānaṃ hotīti.
sn44.9:6.4: yasmiñca pana bho gotama, samaye imañca kāyaṃ nikkhipati, satto ca aññataraṃ kāyaṃ anuppanno hoti, imassa pana bhavaṃ gotamo kiṃ upādānasmiṃ paññāpeti?
sn44.9:6.5: yasmiṃ kho vaccha samaye imañca kāyaṃ nikkhipati, satto ca aññataraṃ kāyaṃ anuppanno hoti, tamahaṃ taṇhūpādānaṃ vadāmi.
sn44.9:6.6: taṇhāhissa vaccha, tasmiṃ samaye upādānaṃ hotīti.
